rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding enumeration
fused form of siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ and mūla-kaulam with sandhi; compounds naming attainment of powers and the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the eightfold attainment of powers identified as the root Kaula?
premises: The preceding powers are enumerated as a group of eight.
These eight are characterized as the attainment of powers.
This eightfold attainment is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The enumerated eight powers together constitute the attainment of siddhis and are equated with the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact internal sandhi resolution within the fused token siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: And these eight are the attainment of powers, O fair-faced one; this is the root Kaula.
